newsitem.title: CANADA: Hydro-Quebec buys further 6 pct of Noverco Inc.
newsitem.headline: Hydro-Quebec buys further 6 pct of Noverco Inc.

text.p: Gaz de France said on Thursday it had sold six percent of its interest in holding company Noverco Inc to Hydro-Quebec for C$46.6 million.

Gaz de France said that following the transaction, it maintains a 17.6 percent holding in Noverco, confirming that it will remain an industrial partner of Noverco. The 6 percent Noverco stake was held by Laurentides Investissements S.A., a subsidiary of Gaz de France.
Noverco owns 100 percent of Gaz Metropolitain Inc, Quebec's natural gas distributor. Gaz Met also owns Northern New England Gas Corp and Vermont Gas Systems Inc.

The transaction comes after Hydro-Quebec's acquisition of a 32 percent stake in Noverco on January 13. Hydro-Quebec acquired the 32 percent stake from Quebec public pension fund manager Caisse de depot et placement for C$306 million immediately after the Caisse bought the stake from SOQUIP, a Quebec government energy agency.

Following the latest transaction, the holdings in Noverco are as follows, Hydro-Quebec 38.16 percent, Caisse de depot et placement du Quebec 35.88 percent, Laurentides Investissements S.A. 17.56 percent, and investment dealer Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion Inc. 8.40 percent.
Hydro-Quebec has an option on the 8.40 percent of Noverco shares held by Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion.
Hydro-Quebec and Gaz Metropolitain remain separate corporate entities, and the commercial context in which the two companies operate remains unchanged, Hydro-Quebec said.

On behalf of Gaz de France, Jean Abiteboul, chairman of Novergaz, said the transaction was carried out at the initiative of Gaz de France, and will allow the company to pursue its industrial mission with Noverco while making a profitable transaction for Gaz de France.

"We look forward with enthusiasm to continuing to develop Noverco and its operating arms Gaz Metropolitain and Novergaz through united action by Noverco and Hydro-Quebec outside Quebec, on the North-American and international scenes," he said.
Hydro-Quebec said it was pleased to be able to count on the active contribution of Gaz de France in pursuing Noverco's development objectives.

Hydro-Quebec is a Quebec government-owned utility that generates, distributes and markets most of the electricity produced in the province for domestic and U.S. customers. The Caisse de depot is Quebec's public pension and insurance fund manager, and has C$51 billion of assets under management, making it Canada's largest institutional investor.
Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion is an investment banker owned by National Bank of Canada NA.TO, which is Canada's sixth-largest bank. Both are based in Montreal.
